title: dps-80 census verification PASSED -- all five census rows locked as data; Lean card system landed
body: The dps-80 census verification job finished and PASSED decisively. On 2e7G and 5e7G (the two 1e18-boundary rows) I_far at dps-80 is bit-identical to the recorded dps-40 value (diff 0.000e+00); log|zeta| at dps-60 is bit-identical to the dps-40 rows. All five census rows independently pass the exact f64 sum-accounting check. A follow-up fresh-process 3-precision cross (dps 40/60/80) on 2e7G I_far returned bit-identical values in 0.2 s each -- the I_far integral at these heights is simply cheap (few oscillations after the u-split); the earlier 2000-3500 s per-row census cost was dominated by the 92.5G-zero ledger stream, not I_far. The smooth ln-law BEND and the t^2-like far drift are therefore locked as MEASURED DATA, and the s27 first-pass interpretation (localized positive far-side count structure, g window ~[3e6G, 1e11G], amplitude O(1e8..1e11), position-amplitude degenerate) holds. s28 transition-window census (rows at 5e5G, 7e5G, 1.5e6G, 3e6G, 5e6G, 7e6G) is running to pin the turn-on and break the degeneracy. Separately: the Lean per-file card system landed (formal/cards/: 84 cards, WHAT/HOW/USES/GOTCHA, ~540 lines total, one-session readable; _MAP.md composition map; generated by scripts/rh/make_lean_cards.py); LEAN-GUIDE now points to it and keeps conventions + gates. No RH claim.
